svg.text: METAPHRAND ENGINE — the artifact chain
One spine: each stage emits a typed artifact · a gate guards each transition · notes flow ONE stage back, never against a prior draft of itself.
notes / repairs route UPSTREAM — Wilder: a third-act problem is a first-act problem
0 · IDEA
The premise in the author's words — a sentence, an image, a "what if." Plot is not yet a story.
1 · GROUND TRUTH — the constitution
Every later note diffs against THIS, forever. Egri premise (X leads to Y) · dramatic argument + the other side's BEST case
· designing principle · the lighthouse scene (the DNA, written first, in prose) · authorial stake (what a safe version wouldn't
risk saying) · the contested object + WHY both cannot have it · the opponent's plan (succeeds absent the hero).
■ DramaCards.groundTruth — typed, live
GATE A ■ DramaGate.checkTruth
premise grammar · antithesis real · mutual exclusion WRITTEN · plan ≥ 3 steps
2 · SPINE — causality as a type, escalation as telemetry
Beats on BUT | THEREFORE edges — "and then" has no constructor (a beat pair it fits has no legal encoding).
Per-beat corkboard: POV want + obstacle · proximate cause · fortune −5..+5 · stakes 1..10 · the question thrown forward.
■ DramaCards.spine — typed, live (proven: safe FOUR OLDS outline fails 10 ways; v2 passes)
GATE B ■ DramaGate.checkSpine
curve alive (bottom ≤ −3, lands late) · stakes never retreat · no luck rescue · antagonist ACTING at the climax
3 · WORLD & CAST — a populated world, not a corridor
Orchestration: principals on opposed poles · the character web (each a different answer to the argument) · natal chart →
voice card per name · off-model casting + voice donors · each one crazy in a different key.
▲ CHARTS.md · VOICE_CARDS.md (doc artifacts)
✕ preflight.py hard-stop — dead since the Python purge
GATE C ▲ fullness + blind attribution
where are the women? who has a life? · cover the names — ✕ blind_attribution.py dead
4 · SCENE MAP + CARDS — every scene asks permission to exist
The four-masters invariant on one card: want / wall / cost / clock (Mamet–Sorkin) · truthIn ≠ truthOut (Mazin) · a named
value's charge flips (McKee) · audience ledger — each danger tagged suspense or twist (Hitchcock) · the forward question.
■ DramaCards.sceneCard — typed, live
GATE D ■ DramaGate.checkCard
thin litmus blocks · no flip = nonevent · empty audience ledger blocks
5 · CLEAN-ROOM RENDER — the amnesiac writer
Fresh context holding ONLY the spec: ground truth + card + voice cards + the constitution. Never the conversation,
never a prior draft — the meeting cannot leak into the artifact because it does not exist in the writer's world.
■ scene text + receipt (Seed → Write → emit + receipt → verify)
GATE E ■ words-are-law receipt
proof-of-generation — the deliverable comes only from the pipeline
6 · SUBSTANCE BATTERY → THE AUTHOR — is this the right scene?
Before any polish: drama (the fight) · the two changes (Mercurio) · heart ledger (deposits / priced kindness) · intrigue +
held cards · likability · civilian pass · layer cards (PaRDeS). Rewrites re-derive from stages 1–4, never from draft N−1.
▲ skills / stateful-editor passes
✕ drama.py · heart.py · scene_craft.py · density.py — dead
● CHECKPOINT — the author approves substance; structure locks here
7 · FINISHING BATTERY — fenced: line law only, structure is locked
Humanizer (AI tells) · clear-pane · the One Law (naturalness) · idiom / calque · echo + appended-fact · trim · fountain hygiene.
Runs late AND narrow — never polish a draft that may still be rewritten.
▲ skills
✕ craftlint.py · naturalness.py · showing.py · prose_gates.py — dead
8 · PERFORMANCE & PRODUCTION — no raw text reaches an API
Perf.load is the only door (re-runs words-are-law + total coverage) · tagged performance JSON is the maintained artifact ·
cached TTS per voice+line · DME stems (dialogue / atmos+spot / music) → −16 LUFS master · frames / video · receipts.
■ Perf.res (sealed opaque type) · Mix3.res — typed, live
CROSS-CUTTING LAWS (every stage)
Transcript ≠ artifact.
Generation contexts never contain the conversation.
Notes hit the anterior artifact only.
Scenes vs. cards, cards vs. spine, spine vs. ground truth —
never a draft vs. its own previous draft.
Stage rubrics.
Each gate judges its own altitude — no line critics on outlines,
no structure notes at the polish stage.
Memory for critics, amnesia for writers.
The editor keeps history (fresh critics rotate notes);
the writer sees only the spec.
Entropy at the seed.
Perturb one recipe variable off-mode, then execute normal —
signature is a seed-time property; no pass adds it later.
Guardrails outside the agent.
Remove the capability, don't instruct around it.
The human is the stop.
Checkpoints gate forward motion; nothing auto-ships.
THE HONEST FINDING (Frankenstein audit)
The chain IS one spine, not a patchwork. The scene invariant
appears three times ON PURPOSE — permission (Gate D),
judgment (stage 6), advisory (the skill) — one law, three doors.
DEBT 1 — law without a bailiff.
The Python purge (2026-07-10) killed the runners the docs
still cite: preflight · blind_attribution · drama · heart · density ·
showing · concreteness · scene_craft · craftlint · naturalness ·
doorways · prose_gates · editor. Stages 1–2, 4–5, 8 block
mechanically (■); stages 3, 6, 7 are currently doctrine + skills
only (▲/✕). Port the bailiffs to ReScript or run as fenced skills.
DEBT 2 — edge honesty is unverified.
BUT|THEREFORE forces the claim to exist; nothing yet checks
the claim is true (an and-then can hide behind a Therefore).
Needs the blind read-back: summarize, re-derive labels cold.
DEBT 3 — no regression memory.
Draft-over-draft diffs (stakes-shrink, curve-flattening) need
stored curves per draft; today only the current spine is judged.
DEBT 4 — the table read is missing.
The strongest civilian gate the industry has; we own the TTS
plumbing (stage 8) and don't yet point it at drafts (stage 6).
LEGEND
■ typed gate — ReScript, compiles & blocks (live)
▲ LLM pass / skill — advisory, needs a runner
✕ dead pointer — doc cites a purged enforcer
● human checkpoint — the stop

Sources: docs/01–08 · studio/src (DramaCards, DramaGate, UxCards/UxGate, Perf, Mix3, Write) · the canon research (Mamet, Sorkin, Mazin, McKee, Egri, Truby, Parker/Stone, Gilroy, Kaufman, Hitchcock, Vonnegut, Grillo-Marxuach) · memory laws.
The two ends are hard (typed conception, typed production); the middle is where the law still outruns the bailiffs.
